name: Will my homeowner's insurance cover bathtub overflow damage?

mainEntity.name: Will my homeowner's insurance cover bathtub overflow damage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most standard homeowner's insurance policies typically cover damage caused by sudden and accidental water discharge, such as a bathtub overflow. However, coverage can vary depending on the specific policy and the cause of the overflow. Damage due to negligence or lack of maintenance (e.g., a long-term leaky faucet) might not be covered. It's crucial to review your policy details and contact your insurance provider immediately after the incident. A professional restoration company can often assist with documentation and direct billing to simplify the claims process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Homeowner's insurance usually covers sudden and accidental bathtub overflows, but not damage from negligence. Check your policy and contact your provider immediately. Professionals can help with claims.
